description: Simulated actuator dynamics between the joint velocity command and the MuJoCo velocity servos (actuator.py, docs/ACTUATOR_MODEL.md). These values are simulation assumptions, not measurements of a real drive. Each limit may be one number (all joints) or six numbers (one per joint).

ideal.note: No actuator dynamics: the servo receives the command unchanged (the behaviour before this model).

default.note: Assumed limits: 0 to 0.35 rad/s in about 0.19 s, 0.35 rad/s to 0 in about 0.10 s.

gentle.note: Slower starts and resumes; the same braking deceleration as default.
